strings.name: Jimmy Wales
strings.summary: After finance studies and trading, Wales helped launch Wikipedia with Larry Sanger and others in 2001, replacing slow expert review with open editing. He established the Wikimedia Foundation and explored commercial wikis and news communities. Global volunteers build the encyclopedia; his role centers on organization, advocacy and governance. Reliability and bias remain challenges.
